name: Gorgias
one_liner: Ecommerce-focused helpdesk with a REST API for tickets, customers, macros, rules and integrations.
auth_notes: Private integrations use HTTP Basic (account email + API key from Settings > REST API). OAuth2 is mandatory for any third-party app and required for App Store listing.
access_notes: Pricing page: 'Start free trial No credit card required'; API rate limit 2 req/s listed on every plan. Distributable OAuth apps need partner-portal registration and tech partnership review; developer sandbox requires emailing techpartners.

buildability.rationale: A per-account API key is self-serve after a trial, but a distributable OAuth2 app (mandatory for third-party apps) goes through Gorgias partner review; limits 40/80 requests per 20s.

evidence.quote: Using OAuth2 is mandatory for any 3rd party app.
Currently all new Sandbox accounts are Demo accounts by default.
API key integrations** can make 40 requests in a 20 second window
